reviewer_scope: Independently read all 136 current nonretail paragraphs and all 91 distinct exact cited own-date headline records, including Polish-language records. Checked assertion scope, source ages by meaning, actual release availability, result versus preview and forecast, company roles, attribution, local support, consistent actions and market/flow distinctions. Compared every quoted market level, return, yield and yield change with the correct own-date instrument, completed session, horizon, currency/unit and split context. Checked current-date source and release exclusions and the author's conservative omissions; none is cited. Re-read named edited strings. No Aug30 input was read before this acceptance.

basis: US compares exceptional Nvidia revenue growth with a demanding expectation hurdle and confidence/job anxiety, then distinguishes a minimally positive curve from repaired borrower fundamentals.

China contrasts Meituan revenue resilience and industrial-profit improvement with PDD repricing, weak manufacturing, producer-price pressure, mainland housing and bank margin constraints; cross-border African lending remains separate from domestic credit transmission.

Poland treats the proposed 2025 defence budget, deficit and housing-credit allocation as future policy choices, connects them to public financing and procurement, and compares CD Projekt, PKO, Orlen, PZU and Dino through separate operating and capital-use channels.

Sectors identify disclosure risk, content costs, insurer property exposure, fleet transition, competition, commercial access, energy capacity and tariff-driven investment without collapsing them into a uniform easing trade.

Earnings and catalysts distinguish strong business results from valuation surprises; SMCI filing delay remains separate from proven allegations. Currency options, announced buybacks, NISA allocation and asset prices retain different meanings. Forward scenarios have distinct demand, contract, funding and margin triggers.

findings.action: Explicitly labelled Amazon/Wondery and Uber as comparisons outside the respective XLC/XLY sectors, and PetroChina and Fortescue as foreign producer comparisons.

Added local China/Poland divergence, housing-budget and Treasury support; moved Poland's general cash-timing comment before its final divergence. Kept all citations at no more than three nonretail uses.

Removed an unsupported Japan industrial comparison; made Meituan outperformance a revenue-expectation assessment; replaced unsupported defensive/financing price-cause statements with entry-price implications; clarified that option premiums reduce net return while a purchased option need not cap favorable currency participation; removed unnecessary copper-ratio framing.
Formatted all six catalyst titles with $TICKER.

Nvidia, Salesforce and CrowdStrike actual after-close results are eligible before Aug29. Their quoted Aug28 regular-session prices explicitly precede the reports, rather than being called completed-session reactions. SMCI filing delay and same-session decline are now actual, while short-seller allegations remain unproven. Premature euro-area inflation, doubtful mortgage-rate-low material, report-day US GDP and report-day European inflation actuals are absent.

Poland defence spending, 5.5% GDP deficit and specific zero housing-credit allocation remain proposed 2025 budget choices, not completed spending or universal withdrawal of housing support. Buybacks, Xpeng production and Sydney housing remain plans; Fortescue iron-ore confidence remains an attributed management forecast.

Completed Aug28 market sessions and UTC daily crypto observations match. SMCI 443.49 USD is the historical pre-split nominal unit. The 3.83%/3.84% Treasury curve is positive but very flat with a 1bp spread and twenty-observation bull steepening; five-observation yield directions remain mixed. ETF prices are not credit spreads or flows. Numeric spot-FX and copper-derived growth signals are absent.

limits: Evidence consists of exact dated headline records and current-vintage historical market cards, not full publisher article bodies or original unrevised data vintages.
Acceptance binds the exact current nonretail component only. Retail is independently reviewed; subsequent nonretail edits require renewed review and binding.

exact_block_ranges.method: Independent paragraph-body whitespace count after removing canonical citation tokens; all 36 exact AUTHORING bounds.
